text:
Predicates:
Appropriate(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
ChildrenWatch(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance from parents.
ExcessiveErotic(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic content.
ExcessiveViolent(x) ::: x contains excessive violent content.
RatedGA(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
FrozenSeries(x) ::: x is in the Frozen series.
Hachi(x) ::: x is 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale'.
Premises:
Appropriate(x) → ChildrenWatch(x) ::: If a film is appropriate for people of all ages, then children can watch it without guidance from parents.
(ExcessiveErotic(x) ∨ ExcessiveViolent(x)) → ¬ChildrenWatch(x) ::: If a film contains excessive erotic and violent content, children cannot watch it without guidance from their parents.
RatedGA(x) → Appropriate(x) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for people of all ages.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGA(x) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
FrozenSeries(x) → FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
Hachi(x) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
Hachi(x) ⊕ Appropriate(x) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages.
Conclusion:
ExcessiveErotic(hachi) ⊕ FrozenSeries(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' contains excessive erotic and violent content or is in the 'Frozen' series or both.
